# FileTextContentRequest

A file's content as text.

**Kind:** an object, used in requests.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` | `string` | yes | The file's text, up to 100 MB. Whitespace is kept exactly as sent. Constraints: maxLength: 100000000, required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |

## Example

```json
{
  "content": "..."
}
```

## Where it's used

- [`vfs.open(name).append`](../api/vfs.md) (`PUT /namespaces/{namespaceName}/vfs/by-name/{name}/files/append/text`)
- [`vfs.open(name).writeText`](../api/vfs.md) (`PUT /namespaces/{namespaceName}/vfs/by-name/{name}/files/write/text`)
- [`vfs.openById(id).append`](../api/vfs.md) (`PUT /vfs/by-id/{id}/files/append/text`)
- [`vfs.openById(id).writeText`](../api/vfs.md) (`PUT /vfs/by-id/{id}/files/write/text`)
